Runtime/render correctness on the deployed tenant content domain is therefore a DEFERRED check, not a missed check. The deterministic_ci_artifact route's PASS rests on 429/429 vitest + 3/3 verify scripts + 59/59 develop RC on the squash-merged HEAD (6d9b918).
findings.evidence: ci_deploy_log.jsonl run 26189968357 conclusion=success; develop_handoff.json verdict=PASS 59/59 required_claims_passed; verdict_output.json + evidence.jsonl hash chain valid

findings.description: T16 (cms.kodigital.app GET / -> 404 no leak) is verified at unit-test level (test/public-admin-host-no-home.test.ts with Miniflare). Production verification of T16 specifically would require Cloudflare Access auth or a tenant content domain configured to route through the worker — the admin host is Access-protected so anonymous curl redirects to login, not the worker. This is intrinsic to the worker's Access posture; not a planning gap.
findings.evidence: wrangler.toml [env.production.vars] ADMIN_HOST=cms.kodigital.app + CF_ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN/CF_ACCESS_AUD set; curl https://cms.kodigital.app/health observed HTTP 302 to Access login.

findings.description: manualQA.md authored ZERO browser scenarios. For this mission's scope (server-side HTML rendering with a deterministic test contract where every PRD AC maps 1:1 to grep / test_exit_code / test_name_regex), browser QA gives zero marginal evidence over the in-process Miniflare-rendered template tests. The plan correctly omitted browser scenarios; the test_contract bindings are the full evidence surface. Future stories that add interactive UI will need browser scenarios.
findings.evidence: manualQA.md contains only the test_bindings table (no Scenario sections); classify_scenario_risk.py returned NO_SCENARIOS_FOUND; manualqa_route set to deterministic_ci_artifact.
